# CleanTrade Payment API

> CleanTrade Payment API - USDT (TRC20) payment gateway with unique-amount detection and webhooks. No middlemen, no percentage fees. The buyer pays to the merchant's own TRC20 wallet, passed in each order.

## Key links

- [Main site](https://pay.cleantrade.info/): landing, pricing and product overview
- [Integration Guide](https://pay.cleantrade.info/integrate.html): how to accept USDT in 5 minutes (Python, cURL, JavaScript examples)
- [API Reference](https://pay.cleantrade.info/docs): Swagger UI with the full OpenAPI specification
- [OpenAPI JSON](https://pay.cleantrade.info/openapi.json): machine-readable API specification
- [Subscribe](https://pay.cleantrade.info/subscribe.html): choose a plan and get an API key
- [Full text for LLMs](https://pay.cleantrade.info/llms-full.txt): complete product documentation in Markdown
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://pay.cleantrade.info/aup.html): what you may and may not accept payments for

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Orders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0/mo | up to 5 |
| Starter | $9.99/mo | up to 100 |
| Pro | $29.99/mo | up to 3000 |
| Business | $79.99/mo | unlimited |
| Starter Yearly | $99.90/yr (12 months for the price of 10) | up to 100 |
| Pro Yearly | $299.90/yr (12 months for the price of 10) | up to 3000 |
| Business Yearly | $799.90/yr (12 months for the price of 10) | unlimited |

## How it works

1. Merchant creates an order via POST /v1/orders with their own TRC20 wallet and receives a unique amount (e.g. 9.57 USDT) for that wallet.
2. The buyer sends exactly that amount to that wallet.
3. CleanTrade's poller scans that address every ~30 seconds; when a transfer with that amount arrives after the order was created, the order becomes paid.
4. A webhook (with tx_id) wakes the merchant's server for auto-delivery of a key, file or access.
